data.why: No small bundled example data ship with the pip package (tests/demo_data/*.csv/.ris are tiny format-edge-case fixtures, not a realistic review dataset), and the SYNERGY benchmark sets the app can fetch require live internet the sandboxed server won't have, so a small CSV matching ASReview's expected columns (title, authors, abstract, keywords, doi, year, included) was written with a near-duplicate pair, a non-systematic/irrelevant study, two blank 'included' values to label during screening, and one record with a missing abstract.

goals: import a dataset of search results (title/abstract records) to start a new systematic review project
mark a handful of records as prior knowledge (relevant and irrelevant) to seed the active-learning model
screen records the model ranks as most likely relevant, labeling each as relevant or irrelevant
monitor screening progress (number labeled, relevant found) on the project dashboard
export the labeled dataset or project file once a stopping point is reached

review.summary: The tree describes ASReview LAB's screening workflow accurately, in phases that match the README, and most of the 14 screens I opened back up their nodes. It still needs fixes: the core active-learning loop is evidenced by one decision on pre-labelled data, the labelled-records export has no task and never worked, and t10–t13 plus f7/f8 were never replayed.
